root_cause: tt_face_load_svg_doc reads the gzip trailer's ISIZE as uncomp_size and passes it to FT_QALLOC without a cap. Before this introduction, the public glyph loader did not call the SVG document loader. The 2025 fix bounds ISIZE; an equivalent small guard applies to the 2022 tree.
findings: The newly added glyph-load call reaches tt_face_load_svg_doc. That parser trusts the gzip trailer's uncompressed size and requests a buffer of that size before imposing a cap.
